headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Total consolidated net revenue across Google Services, Google Cloud, and Other Bets.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Consolidated Net Revenue ($M): Wall Street consensus (LSEG) models $128,220M ($128.22B) in Q3 2026E (+25.3% YoY vs $102,346M in Q3 2025); buy-side whisper targets $130,000M ($130.0B) fueled by hyper-growth in Google Cloud AI compute and YouTube subscriptions.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Wall Street consensus Diluted EPS for Class A voting shares Q3 2026E ($3.00) vs Buy-Side Whisper ($3.15).
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Diluted EPS ($): Sell-side consensus expects $3.00 per Class A share; buy-side whisper bogeys target $3.15+ driven by operating leverage across Google Services and expanding Cloud operating margins.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Total revenue generated by Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Google Workspace enterprise accounts.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Google Cloud Revenue ($M): Printed $24,800M ($24.8B) in Q2 2026 (+82% YoY); Street consensus models $28,700M for Q3 2026E (+89.4% YoY vs $15,157M in Q3 2025) with buy-side whisper looking for $29,500M+ on surging generative AI infrastructure demand and custom TPU deployments.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Core advertising revenue generated on Google Search, Maps, and AI Overviews query surfaces.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Google Search Revenue ($M): Core search engine printed $63,300M in Q2 2026; Street consensus models $64,850M in Q3 2026E (+14.6% YoY vs $56,567M in Q3 2025; whisper $65,500M) as AI Overviews ads monetize commercial queries.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Advertising revenue generated across YouTube video placements and Shorts.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: YouTube Advertising Revenue ($M): Printed $11,100M in Q2 2026; Street models $11,400M in Q3 2026E (+11.1% YoY vs $10,261M in Q3 2025) with whisper at $11,650M fueled by Shorts monetization and connected TV share.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Capital expenditures deployed toward AI servers, custom TPUs, networking, and data center buildouts.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: AI Infrastructure CapEx ($M): Reached $44,924M in Q2 2026 as Alphabet aggressively scaled data centers; Street expects Q3 CapEx around $45,000M–$48,000M to support Gemini foundation model training and GCP customer inference.
